summary: Shows the mask_secrets filter for redacting registered secrets from a string you write elsewhere, such as a log file on the node, with an optional custom placeholder.
questions: How do I strip secrets from output I write to a file?
Can I use a different placeholder than $REDACTED$?

answer_card.title: Redacting output with mask_secrets
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.copy:
    content: "{{ command_result.stdout | mask_secrets }}"
    dest: /var/log/deploy-summary.log

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ 'token=' ~ api_token | mask_secrets(mask_placeholder='***') }}"
```
